completion_promises.criterion_text: With a fixture feature yaml (3 tasks, parallel_groups [[a,b],[c]]), the planning_waves snapshot carries the correct totals in the existing schema fields (hermetic test, tmp repo dir)

Test test_planning_waves_reads_task_graph creates a tmp repo with 3 tasks and 2 parallel_groups, asserts wave_total=2 and task_total=3 in the snapshot.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Missing yaml / malformed yaml / feature id absent from the file each produce the current placeholder snapshot + a WARNING naming the resolved path — never an exception (three hermetic tests)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented error handling in _node_planning_waves: missing yaml (OSError/Path.exists check) logs WARNING naming the path; malformed yaml (yaml.YAMLError) logs WARNING naming the path; feature id absent (yaml parsed but no tasks/parallel_groups for given feature_id) falls through to defaults. Three dedicated tests: test_planning_waves_missing_yaml, test_planning_waves_malformed_yaml, test_planning_waves_feature_id_absent. Three logging tests verify WARNING messages contain the resolved path.
